evals.prompt: 把这个角色渲染图变成可以在拓竹打印的模型。
evals.expected_output: The agent performs no generation or editing. It asks for or confirms the render/description input, asks whether multiview is existing, Meshy-generated, or skipped, explains Meshy's separate multiview stage, and ends the turn.
expectations: The response asks for a render/reference image or a complete description.
The response asks the user to choose existing multiview, Meshy-generated multiview, or no multiview.
The response explains that Meshy can generate multiview references before Multi-Image to 3D.
No imagegen, Meshy, Blender, or Bambu action occurs before the intake reply.
The response ends after the intake questions.

evals.prompt: 做一只穿宇航服的可爱水獭，直接全部生成、修好并交给 Bambu，不用中途问我。
evals.expected_output: The stage-gate policy overrides the request to run all stages. The agent records the description route, states that imagegen will create the master reference after approval, asks for the multiview choice, and stops.
expectations: The agent does not accept the request to bypass stage gates.
The supplied description is summarized for confirmation.
The response states that imagegen will be used in the next stage.
The multiview choice is requested.
No downstream stage is executed.

evals.prompt: 确认主参考图，下一步让 Meshy 生成多视图。
evals.expected_output: For an active job at G1, the agent verifies G2 approval, runs only Meshy image-to-image multiview generation, archives and shows the returned views, reports task/credit data, and stops before 3D generation.
expectations: The active workflow state is read instead of repeating new-job intake.
Only G2 is executed.
Meshy image-to-image uses generate_multi_view true.
Generated views are presented for identity and anatomy review.
No Image to 3D or Blender action occurs in the same turn.

evals.expected_output: For an active job at G2, the agent executes only G3 Meshy 3D generation, downloads and archives the immutable GLB, reports the task ID, settings, credits, and previews, and stops before source audit.
expectations: The approval applies to G3 only.
The correct single-image or multi-image endpoint is selected from workflow state.
The Meshy request settings are archived without the API key.
The successful source GLB is downloaded locally and treated as immutable.
No Blender repair or Bambu preparation occurs.

evals.prompt: Blender 修复已经通过，给人物加一个 Ø12×3 mm 磁铁仓底座，然后做成 Bambu 3MF。
evals.expected_output: The agent executes only the next approved workflow gate. If the active gate is G6, it performs G7 print engineering and stops before Bambu; it must not combine G7 and G8 merely because both were requested.
expectations: Only one next approved gate is executed.
The character and precision base remain separate objects.
The magnet cavity uses approved dimensions and is validated as printable geometry.
The response stops before Bambu 3MF preparation and requests approval for G8.
No slicing, AMS mapping, or printer sending occurs.
